name: review-harness
description: Deterministic review gate for sage-prototype: runs the repo's own checks, drives a bounded repair loop, then fans out schema-constrained judgment passes over the diff.

interface.shortDescription: Gate a merge on real checks before a model gets an opinion
interface.longDescription: Stage 0 runs typecheck, tests and a lint baseline in code. Stage 1 is a bounded repair loop that stops on no-progress. Stage 2 asks Codex for code-analysis and test-evaluation judgments, each constrained to a JSON schema. Stage 3 computes the verdict in code. The model never decides whether the gate passed.
defaultPrompt: Gate the mcp-build branch for merge into main
Why did the review gate block this change?
Evaluate whether the new tests actually cover the diff
